source_probability_and_declaration.paper_Eq8: No explicit D; setting D=1 alone does not reproduce the paper due to Eq6 and other protocol differences
source_probability_and_declaration.variance: sum_s p_s*((x_s-mu_x)^2+(y_s-mu_y)^2), full posterior covariance trace
source_probability_and_declaration.native_stop: variance strictly < 1.0 m2 in PMFS::checkSourceFound; search-time and map-wait precedence retained
source_probability_and_declaration.convergence_steps_semantics: Present parameter is not an extra five-success stopping requirement in the audited checkSourceFound implementation
source_probability_and_declaration.readout: expectedValueSource(0.05): probability-weighted XY of highest-probability ceil(0.05*N) original candidate cells
source_probability_and_declaration.tie_rule: Original std::sort probability-only comparator; no stable tie-break promised. Retain saved native readout. Report ambiguity if tied cutoff is material.
source_probability_and_declaration.truth_distanceThreshold: 0.5 m only for the separate truth-assisted navigation-time diagnostic; never a causal inference/planning input or variance declaration gate
native_metrics: Top-5% weighted declaration XY error in meters
physical search time to native declaration in seconds
source_probability_and_declaration.censoring: Original recording exhaustion and separate safety stop do not produce native declarations; do not replace absent times with a short cap

observation_and_planning.per_update_limits: All per-role GSL parameters embedded above; maxUpdatesPerStop=5, stepsSourceUpdate=3, initialExplorationMoves=2
observation_and_planning.propagation: deltaTime=.1, iterationsToRecord=200, maxWarmupIterations=500. Retain native termination criterion; no mandatory200-step warmup.
observation_and_planning.planning: Original openMoveSetExpasion=5, explorationProbability=.05, localEstimationWindowSize=2; retain native planner and move-set ordering
